designationHistory.indexText: Kirtland’s Warbler Wildlife Management Area was established in 1980 in response to the need for more land dedicated to the recovery of the Kirtland’s warbler, which was on the endangered species list from 1967 to 2019.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
